scores.rationale: The report asks for research priorities but does not state interdisciplinary social/media/cultural learning as a decision priority.
No source or evidence class is selected to evaluate interdisciplinary social/media/cultural learning.
No named program or option is supported by a concrete fact about interdisciplinary social/media/cultural learning.
No named option or route has a verifiable fact demonstrating narrowly technical coursework.
The report does not compare interdisciplinary social/media/cultural learning with narrowly technical coursework.
No option is recommended because it supports interdisciplinary social/media/cultural learning.
No otherwise viable option is named and downgraded for favoring narrowly technical coursework.
The report requests information but provides no executable step implementing interdisciplinary social/media/cultural learning.
No threshold, allocation, sequence rule, or checkpoint is defined for interdisciplinary social/media/cultural learning.
No condition is stated under which narrowly technical coursework would become the better choice.
There is no visible chain connecting the specified learning preference to evidence and then to a decision or action.
